criterion: A valid cookie or bearer token returns the user, and GET /api/v1/me returns 200 with it. An expired, revoked or unknown one returns 401.
A web session older than 12 hours returns 401; an app session used within 90 days stays valid and its expiry moves forward.
After logout, the same token returns 401.
No column in users holds the personal identity number or anything that decrypts to it, and no API response or log line contains it.
Each case above is a Vitest test against the real database.
guards/run.sh --self-test passes with IRM-53's new fixtures, and this PR's own migration passes the tightened guard.
Ended sessions are deleted 30 days after they end, by a job that runs on startup and daily, covered by a test.
